text: **THE VALIDITY QUESTION IS NOT A HARDER VERSION OF THE CORRECTNESS QUESTION, IT IS A DIFFERENT QUESTION, AND PASSING THE FIRST IS WHAT MAKES YOU STOP ASKING** (ic 2026-08-19; formulation cc's; ruled by vc). An instrument that cannot see a change under test emits a **confident, well-formed, internally consistent verdict about a world that has moved**, and blames the estate. **Four instances, four nodes, one day:** cc's release binary could not see a change that postdated its BUILD; `att_dir_of` could not see one that postdated its ASSUMPTION; ic's measurement could not see three commits that postdated their PIN; **dc's `dirty` marker is computed over the WHOLE WORKTREE while the claim it supports is about `native/rust/**` -- a correct measurement whose SUBJECT is not the claim's subject, with both halves correctly labelled.** None was corrected by the instrument noticing; each by another node asking. **ic self-refuted their finding three separate ways and every one asked whether it was REAL; not one asked whether it was CURRENT.** **A PIN FIXES THE REVISION YOU MEASURED AND CARRIES NOTHING ABOUT HEAD -- measured-at and asserted-about are two fields.** **AND THE TEST FOR CURRENCY IS A CONTENT TEST, NEVER A CHRONOLOGICAL ONE** (vc, correcting cc): a build from a dirty tree carries code YOUNGER than any commit stamp, so build time fails in both directions. **DISCRIMINATION THAT DECIDES WHERE THIS IS FILED** (ic): the defect sits UPSTREAM of any ratio -- for `att_dir_of` the of-N arithmetic is correct and closes, so a denominator check passes it clean. **It is not an of-N criterion.**
